standard_prerequisites.name: Abelian categories and basic homological algebra

core_obligations: Construct the quotient, its abelian structure and the universal exact factorization from the original calculus-of-fractions argument.
difficulty_reason: The proof builds the category of fractions for a Serre subcategory, establishes its abelian structure and exact quotient functor, and proves the universal factorization property by lifting the relevant kernels, images and morphisms. These categorical constructions remain in the collected proof, not assumed as an existing quotient.
